keywords: Partition action involving land transferred by parents to six children. Defendant claimed prescriptive title through exclusive possession, relying on an informal letter from a co-owner as proof of ouster. Court held the letter amounted only to an agreement to sell, not a valid transfer, and that the defendant had always possessed it as a co-owner. Defendant\'s claim to exclude other co-owners failed. Appeal dismissed.
